## Verdict: CLEAN

The writer record on #4439 is released. The PR is ready, so this review treats that as the hand-off.

### Scope
- The diff has 19 files: guide pages, one decision record and one site test. No file is in `crates/`, `scripts/`, `.github/`, `xtask/`, `.cargo/` or a `Cargo.toml`. No code, G-code, gouge check, collision check or geometry changes. This is not a safety-tier review.
- No `crates/ui` change, so no screenshots are owed.
- No recorded program changed (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`). "Goldens moved: None" is correct.

### Build and tests (local, trial merge with upstream/main 1cf7390dc; HEAD^1 is the PR head)
- `python3 -I -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p 'test_release_028_guide.py'`: 20 tests, OK.
- Full site suite on the PR: 22 failed items.
- Full site suite on bare upstream/main: the same 22, plus `test_manifest_properties_have_reference_rows`. The PR fixes that one.
- The 22 are not caused by this PR. They are `test_guide_icons` (2 icons) and the bold-label checks of the two 4-axis tutorials. The PR body says 28; the count here is 22 because the harness counts subtests differently. The sets are identical.
- Quick gate and clippy: not run. No crate changed.
- Extra suites run: none owed. No `testdata/` change and no importer change.

### Mutations
- In `reference/post-processors.md`, rename `manualToolChange`: `test_post_processor_reference` goes red. Restored: green.
- In `check-and-post/machines.md`, rename "Laser" to "Lsr": the pin `test_release_028_guide.py` goes red (1 failure). Restored: green.
- A rename of "Bore entry" and "left-hand" in `set-up/tools.md` did not turn the pin red. The pin checks other key facts of those sections. This is not a blocker.

### Law check
- Clean-room: the diff has no new mention of `hsmworks` in text.
- No dependency, no process file, no PNG changed.

### Findings
None.

### Optional, non-blocking
- The PR body counts 28 remaining site failures. The local count is 22 on both sides. Align the number at the next edit.
- Text was checked against PR bodies, not in the running app (stated in the PR body).
